thread:
maria: Heads-up: planning to lift the `per-tenant-rate-limit-v2` config for EU+US tomorrow at 11:30 UTC. Goal is staged enable (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with a 30m observation window between steps. Who will flip and own rollbacks?

devon: I can push the toggles. I'll be online at 11:15 UTC. Need confirmation on safe-default behavior (what happens if we roll back vs kill switch).

aj: Sounds good. Quick checklist: 1) health endpoints green, 2) synthetic traffic smoke (see curl below), 3) SLOs/5xx rate and tail latency dashboards hydrated.

aj: Smoke test snippet:```bash
for i in {1..20}; do 
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.internal/v1/tenants/test-tenant/requests?limit=1" >/dev/null && echo ok || echo fail
done
```

sasha: Safe-default = keep legacy limit enforced (flag default = "strict") so user-facing limits won't increase if toggle fails. We flip to variant "lenient" which relaxes per-tenant caps. That means rollback is just flipping back to "strict".

maria: Good. Rollback runbook: flip flag to strict, run smoke script, verify error-rate < baseline + 0.5% for 10m. If we see >0.5% regression or p99 latency +50ms, escalate and revert immediate.

leo: @devon when you flip, please run the following quick checks 0/5/15/30 minutes:
- curl smoke (aj script)
- `sum(rate(service_errors_total[5m]))` (dashboard check)
- token-costs per-tenant spike monitor (just in case)

devon: noted. I'll flip 10% at 11:30, monitor for 30m, then push 50% at 12:05 if stable, full at 12:40. Will post timestamps in thread.

deploy-bot: Canary jobs scheduled: per-tenant-rate-limit-v2-canary (eu-west, us-east) starting 2410001300. Will report pass/fail.

maria: Owner for post-rollout verification: @sasha (metric sigs), @aj (smoke), @leo (ops guardrails). Oncall is @devon until 13:00 UTC.

sasha: Two notes: 1) midnight EU traffic spike window avoided, 2) if any tenant >3x baseline errors, immediate global rollback.

aj: Add a small load test for a high-QPS tenant after 50% stage — 60s burst at 2x baseline, watch queue depth.

devon: Will do bursts at 12:10 after 50% flip. Posting step times: 10% -> 11:30 (starting now), 50% -> 12:05, 100% -> 12:40.

maria: If rollback needed, use:```bash
# flip back to strict
redwood-cli flags set per-tenant-rate-limit-v2 strict --env prod
# verify
redwood-cli flags get per-tenant-rate-limit-v2 --env prod
```

leo: I put a temporary alert: `per_tenant_error_spike` threshold = 3 tenants > 2% errors for 5m -> page. If that fires, treat as immediate stop.

devon: deploy-bot reports: canary passed for eu-west at 2410001335, us-east pending.

deploy-bot: us-east canary passed at 2410001342.

maria: proceeding to 50% in ~30s. Everyone mute non-critical pings for next 45m.

sasha: verifying metrics (first 10m): error-rate = +0.08% (ok), p99 latency +12ms (ok).

aj: smoke tests all green.

maria: thanks team — continue to watch until 13:00 UTC. Will update thread with final 100% completion or rollback decision.

devon: 50% done at 2410001465 (posted). Moving to monitor.

leo: all alerts quiet so far.

maria: follow-up: if anything odd after 12:40 we'll hold at 50% and schedule a short rollback drill. Otherwise final push to 100% at 12:40 as planned.

(End of thread)
